llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed wrapper for submitting Walmart product collection jobs to Dataify, with some credential-use and broad invocation considerations users should understand.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads DATAIFY_API_TOKEN and sends it in an Authorization header to the disclosed Dataify Builder endpoint, which is expected for submitting Dataify tasks but should be visible to users.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installer, background worker, or hidden setup behavior was found; the executable component is a Python standard-library script plus inert SVG assets.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation descriptions and implicit invocation setting are broad, but runtime instructions require a clear collection mode, Walmart-scoped inputs, validation, and no Builder submission until the mode is clear.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not silently persist tokens and tells the agent to ask before giving persistence commands, but it will reuse an already-saved DATAIFY_API_TOKEN without asking the user to re-enter it.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe one purpose: collect Walmart product data by URL, category URL, SKU, or keyword through Dataify Builder, and the script implements that same flow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let the agent create Dataify Walmart collection tasks. Review that DATAIFY_API_TOKEN may be read from your environment and sent to Dataify, and remove or rotate that token if you do not want future runs to use it automatically.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Environment token access and outbound requests are purpose-aligned and disclosed in SKILL.md; no unrelated secret access or alternate endpoint was found.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The routing text and allow_implicit_invocation are broader than ideal for a task-submission skill, but artifact guardrails narrow actual submissions to Dataify Walmart modes with validated Walmart inputs.
[SQP-2] expected: The script sends the provided or saved Dataify token to scraperapi.dataify.com as required for the API call; the endpoint and Authorization header are disclosed in the skill instructions.
[EA2] expected: Reusing DATAIFY_API_TOKEN is conventional for API tooling and the skill forbids calls without a token; users should still know saved credentials may be used for submissions.
